scope: Independent Office numeric/cache integrity review, a proven legal precision-note size fix, generated UTF-8 read/write pairing, and read-only G1 controller audit.

proved_and_fixed.legal_fixture: 5000 rows x 8 columns of finite raw numeric token 1e309; input specification below 256 KiB
proved_and_fixed.previous_failure: Per-cell precision coordinates made manifest exceed workspace file limit after output publication and registration.
proved_and_fixed.fix: Lossless column-row inclusive ranges when grouped notes exceed 192 KiB; budget preflight before authoritative registration or publication; small notes retain cells format.
Explicit strict UTF-8 for service-generated JSON/YAML/SQL/README and frozen Git text. No changes to user-file encoding inference or authorization.
proved_and_fixed.actual_positive_chain: Real source probe, dlt ingestion, dbt builds and quality, post-generation restart reuses commit/job, exact Decimal 118.15 candidate, no publish before confirmation, explicit publish/schedule/export/pause, revision preserves previous published result.

office_compatibility: Default outer OfficeArgs serialization remains unchanged; safe ordinary numbers remain native numeric cells, booleans/nulls and literal formula-like strings retain their types.
Raw JSON decimal tokens parsed as Decimal; nonfinite constants refused. Unsafe precision/range uses declared text_exact with exact cell disclosure.
New grouped_cells_or_column_rows_v1 metadata keeps small cells lists and uses inclusive ranges only when needed. Artifact identity includes metadata format; historical output is not overwritten.

Registered cache requires original independent hash, frozen spec identity, and real OOXML structure; orphan bytes are not adopted. Both pending_saved and file_published os._exit boundaries recover trusted hashes.
No claim of formula recalculation or independent visual validation.

g1_audit.strict_sql_constraints_preserved: Division/IntDiv/AVG, floating casts, scientific/oversized decimal literals, and floating date extraction are rejected; harness does not bypass validators or author answers.
g1_audit.A05_false_is_intentional: No independent rendered page count and clipping proof. No constants changed to produce a pass.
g1_audit.controller_limit: A02-A04 aggregate results are persisted after the A05 model call; an A05 timeout can prevent final summary checkpoint although raw validation/approval evidence remains. No harness change made.
g1_audit.next_actual_run_requirement: Use a newly frozen/current packaged app-root and new evidence directory, not historical r17. Model configuration is passed by path only. No paid run executed here.

unverified_boundaries: This is related regression coverage, not a full-repository pass. Parent owns the final whole-suite run.
No new real-model A02-A05 run; historical G1 failures are not relabeled.
G4 professional visual design and rendered DOCX/PPT clipping/page count remain unverified; only saved content/structure, serialized geometry, and native readers were checked.
No physical clean-machine/disconnected Windows acceptance or final new package validation performed by this audit.
